stem:
Eddie marked the fraction \( \frac{3}{4} \) with a star on the number line shown.

Which of these number lines shows a fraction equivalent to \( \frac{3}{4} \) marked with a star?

options.label: F
options.text: Star at \( \frac{3}{6} \) on number line from 0 to 1 in sixths

options.label: G
options.text: Star at \( \frac{7}{8} \) on number line from 0 to 1 in eighths

options.label: H
options.text: Star at \( \frac{6}{8} \) on number line from 0 to 1 in eighths

options.label: J
options.text: Star at \( \frac{5}{6} \) on number line from 0 to 1 in sixths

visual_elements: Number line 0 to 1 with marks at 0, 1/4, 2/4, star at 3/4, 1
Number line F 0 to 1 with marks at 0, 1/6, 2/6, star at 3/6, 4/6, 5/6, 1
Number line G 0 to 1 with marks at 0, 1/8, 2/8, 3/8, 4/8, 5/8, 6/8, star at 7/8, 1
Number line H 0 to 1 with marks at 0, 1/8, 2/8, 3/8, 4/8, 5/8, star at 6/8, 7/8, 1
Number line J 0 to 1 with marks at 0, 1/6, 2/6, 3/6, 4/6, star at 5/6, 1
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding of equivalent fractions and correctly identifying them on number lines with different denominators.
